subject: prd/local-work-tracker
statement: When a read feeds a destructive or dispatch decision, the tracker shall return an exact, strongly-consistent view that reflects every prior write, never a stale, cached, or index-derived value.
rationale: a stale read once made a shipped item invisible and a second worker rebuilt it (AP-15/INV-7)
fit_criterion: after a write, an immediate strong read reflects it in 100% of an interleave suite; no destructive-path read consults an index that can lag
